text:
Nikhil (Product): quick follow-up from the all-hands pricing qna, need a concise summary for docs and console copy.
Sam (Finance): TL;DR: trial credits do NOT roll over. paid accounts auto-roll up to 25% of monthly credits for one additional month; rolled credits expire after 30 days. enterprise SOWs can override.
Nikhil (Product): automatic for paid accounts?
Sam (Finance): yes, automatic; opt-in only for bespoke enterprise credit packages.
Maya (Eng): enforcement question: if a request arrives with monthly + rollover exhausted, do we throttle or error?
Iris (Support): plan: soft-throttle via a burst buffer for brief spikes; once buffer drained return 429 with retry info.
Maya (Eng): sample 429 payload for SDK/docs: HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{ "error": "quota_exceeded", "detail": "Monthly credits exhausted; burst buffer applied.", "retry_after": 30 }
Nikhil (Product): console copy should be friendly: "You used your monthly credits. Rolled-over credits expire in 30 days. Retry in 30s or upgrade to Dedicated."
Ava (CEO): keep customer messaging simple and identical across marketing/docs.
Sam (Finance): roadmap: Q3 ship per-product buckets (generation, embeddings, rerank) with defaults; customers can request reallocation via support; enterprise can lock in via SOW.
quota-bot: Reminder set  update /docs/credits-rollover by 2026-04-12. Owner: @Nikhil.
Iris (Support): I'll draft FAQ and canned 429 responses.
Maya (Eng): engineering action: implement burst buffer as token-bucket (2x burst, 30s decay), PR next week.
Nikhil (Product): I'll produce a one-pager and small diagram for the all-hands recap email.
Ava (CEO): thanks  flag any SLA/tradeoffs asap. :thumbsup:
